title: Beef and Dumplings Stew
description: A hearty beef stew made with tender dumplings and a rich savory broth.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the carrots and potatoes and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the beef broth, savory soup mix, salt, and pepper.
Return the beef to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours.
Add the dumplings to the pot and cook for an additional 15 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
